نتقاطع (form VI)
# نَتَقَاطَعُ (nataqāṭaʕu) /na.ta.qaː.tˤa.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَقَاطَعَ (taqāṭaʕa)
# نَتَقَاطَعَ (nataqāṭaʕa) /na.ta.qaː.tˤa.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَقَاطَعَ (taqāṭaʕa)
# نَتَقَاطَعْ (nataqāṭaʕ) /na.ta.qaː.tˤaʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَقَاطَعَ (taqāṭaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
